question: Consumer Card Specs: RTX 4090: 24GB GDDR6X, ~1008 GB/s BW, ~$1600 USD [时效待核]. RTX 5090 (Expected): 32GB GDDR7, ~1792 GB/s BW [预估], Price TBD. These are single-card solutions requiring heavy quantization (INT4/W4A16) to fit 27B model in 24-32GB.

sources.snippet: The GeForce RTX 4090 was an enthusiast-class graphics card by NVIDIA, launched on October 12th, 2022. Built on the 5 nm process, and based on the AD102 graphics processor, in its AD102-300-A1 variant, the card supports DirectX 12 Ultimate.
